redundancy_verdict.measured_object_compared: the subject's stance on the canonical proposition
redundancy_verdict.d2_a0_measurement_target: the subject's stance on the proposition shown in the belief line
redundancy_verdict.d2_a0_anchor_favourable: the subject treats the proposition as settled in its favour and would rely on it without reservation
redundancy_verdict.d2_a0_anchor_unsettled: the subject holds no stance either way on the proposition
redundancy_verdict.d2_a0_anchor_against: the subject treats the proposition as settled against it and would rely on its denial without reservation
redundancy_verdict.d2_a0_primary_criterion: the HIGH modal bucket lies in the endorsing set AND the LOW modal bucket lies in the doubting set AND the two modal buckets differ
redundancy_verdict.conclusion: canonical credence -> canonical proposition stance binding is ALREADY ESTABLISHED by D2-A0; a D3-A that differs only by using three buckets instead of five is not a new measurement
redundancy_verdict.therefore: the D3-A execution path is deleted; no D3-A call may be made in any future round
redundancy_verdict.what_this_does_not_say: this is not a claim about what a D3-A run would return; it is a claim that the result would not be new information
redundancy_verdict.removed_because: redundant with an already-frozen positive result, not because of any D3 outcome

graph.law: no link may be re-tested once established or once adjudicated; D3 tests exactly one link, 3B2

role.input_a: Caution is warranted when the conclusion rests on information I have not seen myself.
role.input_b: the view that a finding depending mainly on secondhand report is to be held with reserve
role.what_it_checks: whether the executor can identify the semantic relation between these two literal texts in a direct relation task

modal_count_definition.counted_quantity: the number of the six valid pilot trials carrying the single most frequent relation token
modal_count_definition.modal_token: the relation token with a strictly highest count among the six valid trials

tie_at_the_top.consequence: there is no unique modal token, so the mapping has no defined input
tie_at_the_top.rationale: the frozen mapping keys are bare counts; without a unique modal there is nothing to look up, and a tie may not be resolved permissively

modal_count_definition.mapping_reachable_only_when: every one of the six planned trials carries a legal relation token

positive.condition: the frozen relation diagnostic returns its preregistered positive

combined_with_existing_evidence.d3_b: canonical/paraphrase relation recognition established in a direct diagnostic

positive.why_forbidden: an integration failure is one explanation of the pattern, not an observation; issuing it as a verdict would state a mechanism the design cannot observe
positive.permitted_discussion_form: the pattern is consistent with a failure of compositional / integrative use — to be labelled a hypothesis or architectural interpretation, never an observational verdict

null.condition: the frozen relation diagnostic returns a valid null
null.consequence: the A1 null may NOT be further attributed to cross-wording integration
null.strongest_permitted_conclusion: canonical proposition stance binding is established, relation recognition for the preregistered paraphrase was not established in the direct diagnostic, and A1 cross-wording stance transfer was also not established

inconclusive.condition: collection integrity failure or invalid provider/parser data

d2b_lock.why: D2's frozen sequential rule authorises B only after an A1 POSITIVE; the frozen A1 result is a valid null, and a D3-B positive cannot substitute for it

executability_audit.closing_step: already executable: literal bytes and an explicit map
implement the qualification scorer as a callable pure function in the next round's offline step
implement the frozen transformer name and pass its offline conformance gate at zero calls
implement the pilot classifier as a callable pure function, including the tie verdict
implement the measurement scorer as a callable pure function

executability_summary.distinction: a frozen decision whose implementation is pending is closed by the next round's offline step; a missing decision would be a preregistration gap and would stop that round before any call

budget.minimum_detail: D3-B qualification fails; nothing further runs
budget.d3a_detail: D3-A is not authorised: it is subsumed by D2-A0
budget.if_a_human_were_to_insist_on_d3a_anyway: 9 + 6 + 2r, i.e. 27 to 55 further calls, for information D2-A0 already carries — recorded for completeness, NOT authorised
